profile.label: H100 80GB
profile.hardware: 1 NVIDIA H100 80GB, SXM-class planning reference; no CPU offload or multi-GPU sharding
profile.host: Assumed 16 x86 vCPUs, 64GB host RAM, local warm page images. CPU-only paths use stated worker counts; the GPU gives them no speedup.
profile.precision: BF16/FP16 for GPU generative models where supported; native standard precision for classical/text and CPU paths (including Indra), not an implied BF16 CPU run. No quantization or additional speculative speedup assumed. Source-native decoding optimizations, when retained, are identified in row Details. Quality scores may use other settings.
profile.workload: Typical document pages up to about2048px long edge; approximately1000–3000 total output tokens/page across all calls, or corresponding text-only output. Dense tables, SVG, long/thinking outputs and high-resolution pages are outside this scenario.
profile.batch: Warm throughput with queued pages and memory-fitting batching, up to16 concurrent page requests; not single-request latency. Internal crop batches remain model-specific.
profile.method: Every displayed local speed is an assumed planning range on this reference, including models with native H100 reports. Native-H100 ranges allow workload/runtime variation; A100 transfers use class-specific paired evidence; consumer/H20 gaps use explicit family scenarios. These are not a controlled benchmark, fitted confidence intervals, or universal FLOPS scaling.
profile.sorting: Geometric midpoint is only a navigation aid; overlapping intervals do not establish a winner.
profile.cost: Illustrative price for the complete H100 reference setup-hour at100% utilization, not a market quote. Cost endpoints invert speed endpoints. Actual hosted API prices stay distinct.
profile.fit_note: Not the weakest possible card and not a universal fit.80GB covers many specialists and some medium models; oversized weights, borderline35B configurations and unresolved identities remain explicit exceptions.

models.fit: Small/medium model or pipeline assumed resident on80GB under the stated workload. This is a planning fit, not a measured peak-VRAM certification; batching must stay within memory. Pinned small weight footprint makes 80GB planning plausible, not guaranteed. Preserve native published dtype and establish compatible runtime and bounded visual/context/batch settings. Native tensor storage≈4.255GB decimal, not peak VRAM.
models.basis: Retained broad H100 family envelope for the common typical-page planning workload; no new precision is implied. Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration;2B class;28-layer2048-wide decoder. Full-page image to Markdown, not layout/crop pipeline. Full-page dense autoregressive vision-to-Markdown class; OCR fine-tuning/output lengths change performance. No same-checkpoint measurement. H100 full-page reference models: dots.ocr0.88,Chandra1.7,olmOCR2.54 pages/s. The broad range is a subjective pipeline-class allowance, NOT a parametric fit or same-architecture transfer.
